methodology: Walk-forward expanding window: at each asof, Isolation Forest is fit only on feature windows with window_end < asof-holdout (past-only). Target is scored at asof. Public report anchors (t_peak) mark evaluation windows for quant noise features (Hurst, Shannon, CUSUM, IF score). Metrics include hard hit, pre-peak mean, noise_ramp, and first_fold_hit for regime-level analysis.
sources: Open SSA literature: Shiyan-7 (SY-7) experimental spacecraft associated with proximity-operations discussion in public sources

pre_peak_noise.description: Scores computed ONLY with models trained on data strictly before each fold (no peeking past asof). Compares early vs late noise before public t_peak.
